{{Top|leg}}
A '''Synthnet neural interface''', also '''Synthe-net neural interface''', was a type of technology used in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] to allow the user control of their prosthetics and implants.<ref name="NEW">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Nearly all cybernetics had to be connected to organic tissue at one level or another through a synthnet neural interface. Relatively simple interfaces were used for autonomous organs, such as the heart, which were not consciously controlled and required basic nerve impulses.<ref name="NEW" /> More advanced cybernetics, such as limbs, required far more sophisticated neural interfaces that mapped and replicated a fully functioning nervous system.<ref name="NEW" />
